string.text: %c[ui_gray_1]Fair Fast Travel is replaced by %c[pda_yellow]True Fast Travel%c[ui_gray_1].\n \n%c[pda_white]See %c[pda_yellow]PDA Guide > Addons > True Fast Travel%c[pda_white] for how travel works.

%c[ui_gray_1] 
%c[pda_yellow]True Fast Travel%c[ui_gray_1] walks you along a real nav-mesh path with a spectator camera. Risk stays on the route; you can cancel and reverse.


%c[pda_green]HOW TO TRAVEL
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Open the PDA map and %c[pda_yellow]right-click%c[ui_gray_2] a destination - bases, campfires, or zone exits on the %c[pda_yellow]current map%c[ui_gray_2].
 %c[pda_white]- %c[pda_yellow]Run to%c[ui_gray_2]: Follow the path at your run speed (encumbrance still slows you).
 %c[pda_white]- %c[pda_yellow]Sneak to%c[ui_gray_2]: Same path, crouched - slower, better chance to slip past hostiles.
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Press %c[pda_yellow]Space%c[ui_gray_2] or %c[pda_yellow]Escape%c[ui_gray_2] during travel to cancel. (Escape cannot open the menu while traveling — input is locked for the journey cam.)


%c[pda_green]DURING TRAVEL
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]The camera follows the planned route. Companions stay offline for the trip and rejoin you when it ends.
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Agro or Space cancel starts a slow reverse along the path, then can pause (MCM).
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]An emission stops travel immediately (no reverse) and can pause.
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]You cannot start travel during an emission, when hostiles are too close, when you cannot walk, or (optionally) when unfit.


%c[pda_green]AMBUSHES
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Hostiles along the path can stop you within ambush range. Outer range needs line of sight; an inner range can catch you without it.
 %c[pda_white]- %c[ui_gray_2]Weather and time of day shrink outer range. Sneak travel has a better chance to avoid encounters.


%c[pda_white]Good luck stalker...
